ci_low.question: Confirm the observed diff lies inside the 95 percent CI Compute ci low.
ci_low.reference:
c0, n0 = 17723, 147202
c1, n1 = 17514, 147276
p0, p1 = c0/n0, c1/n1
p = (c0+c1)/(n0+n1)
se = math.sqrt(p*(1-p)*(1/n0 + 1/n1))
z = (p1-p0)/se
pv = 2*(1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(z)))
print(f"z={z:.4f} p={pv:.4f}")
print("significant?", pv < 0.05)  # False



se_u = math.sqrt(p0 * (1 - p0) / n0 + p1 * (1 - p1) / n1)
lo, hi = (p1 - p0) - 1.96 * se_u, (p1 - p0) + 1.96 * se_u
print(round(lo, 6), round(hi, 6))
